followNote: re-measured 11/10/2026 with the per-element probe: the header's dark call to action (.btn-secondary) had its fill on the system's surface and its literal white text (white on white under MotherDuck and Apple); it now takes the system's strongest text as its fill and the page colour as its text, as the template pairs them. The dark stack band (.features-wrap.bg-dark) takes the strongest text as its fill, so under a dark system it turns light while its literal white text stayed (1.16:1 under Moxie); its text takes the page colour. The same holds for the dark 'Play video' button (.btn-dark). The closing call-to-action card is Bootstrap's .bg-white (white !important), which kept its white under a dark system while its text followed (1.16:1 under Moxie): it takes the system's surface; 19/10/2026 (probe v10, 1.0.3): the dark buttons (.btn-secondary, .btn-dark), the dark stack band and the Bootstrap .bg-dark/.bg-secondary fills take the system's ink with its words (on-ink) instead of the strongest text, which under a dark system (Moxie) had made them the lightest fill of the page (BTN-1, GROUND-1, TPL-1); .bg-primary/.bg-info fills read accent-on, the progress bar's words too; .badge-info hover words accent-on and its rim the soft line (HOVER-1); .btn-light words fg, .text-black-50 muted (CON-2); the hero decor's two green fills accent (ACCENT-LEAK, SHAPE-1); the demo screenshot frames written inline white (p style background #fff) the surface (MOCK-1)
sideNote: re-measured 11/10/2026: the page's ground is a lavender picture (.t4-content, images/body-bg.jpg) that no system paints; the worn page's text sat on it (1.03:1 under Moxie, 2.33:1 under MotherDuck on its violet patch at the top), so under a system the picture goes and the system's page colour shows; under a dark system the header's dark wordmark is inverted with its hues kept (the footer, kept, keeps its own); 15/10/2026: the footer now wears the system's ground, so the footer's logo (images/joomlart/logo/item-1.png, a dark wordmark beside the violet mark) all but vanished under a dark system (seen on the about-us page under Moxie at 1440, #1a1a1a ground): under a dark system it is inverted with its hues kept, as the header's. Across the library the footer ground is on the page's side of light for 1330 of 1334 systems (the other four have mid-tone pages); 19/10/2026 (probe v10): the dark buttons' rim is ink on the light side and the second text colour on the dark side (an ink fill on a dark card reads as a lost button without it); the How it works circle icons (features style-3, a green/purple/pink disc with a white glyph) are thresholded to a black disc and white glyph and screened over the accent (darkened to oklch L 0.55 at most, so the white glyph reads), the line icons of features style-4 are drawn in black on the light side and white on the dark side (no picture in the template's green: ACCENT-LEAK); the hero decor's white shapes and strokes read accent-on and its navy lines fg; words on a warning fill take black or white by the fill's lightness (oklch from the warn colour); smart-search buttons share the system's button corner (row shape); the alert close icon is inverted on the dark side
